description: Returns one observation in high detail: nested location with bounding box, consensus taxon, all proposed namings with their per-naming confidence and votes, observer, primary image and full image set, and comments. Use after `search_observations` or `get_recent_fungi` returns an id of interest.

id.description: Mushroom Observer observation id (positive integer). The numeric segment of an MO URL like https://mushroomobserver.org/187521.

name: get_observation
title: Get a Single Mushroom Observer Observation
